title: PX-200 Pressure Transmitter Manual §4.2
text: To recalibrate the PX-200, isolate the process line, open the zero-adjust cover, and hold the ZERO button for five seconds until the LED blinks green.

title: PX-200 Pressure Transmitter Manual §4.3
text: Span calibration on the PX-200 requires a reference pressure source accurate to 0.05% of full scale.

title: PX-200 Pressure Transmitter Manual §6.1
text: The PX-200 does not require periodic recalibration when installed in clean, dry gas service; verify zero annually.

title: PX-200 Pressure Transmitter Manual §2.1
text: The PX-200 operates from 10.5 to 30 V DC and outputs a 4–20 mA signal with HART communication.

title: PX-200 Pressure Transmitter Manual §7.4
text: Error code E-17 on the PX-200 indicates a sensor diaphragm fault; the transmitter must be returned for repair.

title: FM-310 Flow Meter Manual §3.2
text: Install the FM-310 with at least ten pipe diameters of straight run upstream and five downstream to avoid flow profile distortion.

title: FM-310 Flow Meter Manual §5.1
text: Replace the FM-310 flange gasket whenever the meter is removed from the line; reuse of gaskets causes leaks.

title: FM-310 Flow Meter Manual §5.4
text: If the FM-310 display reads zero flow while fluid is moving, check that the electrodes are not coated with scale.

title: FM-310 Flow Meter Manual §2.3
text: The FM-310 is rated for fluid temperatures up to 150 °C with PTFE liner and 80 °C with rubber liner.

title: HX-4410 Heat Exchanger Sensor Datasheet
text: The HX-4410 differential temperature sensor has an accuracy of ±0.1 °C and a response time under 2 seconds.

title: HX-4410 Installation Guide §1.2
text: Mount the HX-4410 probe in a thermowell; never insert it directly into a pressurized line.

title: HX-4410 Firmware Notes 3.2
text: Firmware 3.2 for the HX-4410 fixes a drift issue that appeared after 90 days of continuous operation.

title: HX-441 Legacy Sensor Datasheet
text: The HX-441 is a discontinued legacy temperature switch; its replacement is the HX-4410.

title: Travel and Expense Policy §2
text: Employees may book economy class for flights under six hours; business class requires VP approval.

title: Travel and Expense Policy §5
text: Submit expense reports within 30 days of travel with itemized receipts for any charge over $25.

title: Paid Time Off Policy §1
text: Full-time employees in the United States accrue 15 days of paid time off per year, increasing to 20 days after five years.

title: Paid Time Off Policy §4 (Germany)
text: Employees in Germany receive 28 days of annual leave in accordance with local regulations and company agreements.

title: Information Security Policy §3
text: Customer data must never be copied to personal devices or uploaded to unapproved external services.

title: Information Security Policy §7
text: Report suspected phishing emails using the Report button; do not forward them to colleagues.

title: Remote Work Policy §2
text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval; lab roles are excluded.

title: Support Ticket 1182 (resolved)
text: Customer reported PX-200 reading drifting upward by 2% per week. Root cause: condensation in the impulse line. Fix: installed a drain valve.

title: Support Ticket 1207 (resolved)
text: FM-310 showed zero flow at a water treatment plant. Electrodes were coated with calcium scale; cleaning restored normal readings.

title: Support Ticket 1231 (resolved)
text: Customer asked whether the HX-441 can be repaired. Answer: no, it is end-of-life; quoted HX-4410 upgrade kit.

title: Support Ticket 1250 (open)
text: Refinery customer sees E-17 on three PX-200 units after a pressure spike. RMA requested; awaiting shipping labels.

title: Support Ticket 1266 (resolved)
text: Customer could not connect HART modem to PX-200. Cause: missing 250-ohm loop resistor. Added resistor; communication restored.

title: Engineering Wiki: Release Process
text: Firmware releases require two code reviews, a passing hardware-in-the-loop test run, and sign-off from the product owner.

title: Engineering Wiki: On-Call Guide
text: The on-call engineer acknowledges pages within 15 minutes and escalates safety-related incidents to the duty manager immediately.

title: Engineering Wiki: Hardware-in-the-Loop Lab
text: The HIL lab simulates process conditions for PX and FM devices; book test benches through the lab calendar.

title: Engineering Wiki: Part Numbering
text: Part numbers use a family prefix (PX pressure, FM flow, HX temperature) followed by a model number; suffixes denote options.

title: Supply Agreement: Acme Metals (summary)
text: Acme Metals supplies 316L stainless diaphragms with a 45-day lead time and a 2% annual price cap through 2027.

title: Distribution Agreement: Northfield Controls (summary)
text: Northfield Controls is the exclusive distributor for Halden flow products in Canada; the agreement renews every three years.

title: Product Catalog: PX Family
text: The PX family covers gauge, absolute, and differential pressure transmitters from 0–1 bar to 0–400 bar.

title: Product Catalog: FM Family
text: FM electromagnetic flow meters suit conductive liquids; they cannot measure hydrocarbons or deionized water.

title: New Hire Onboarding Checklist
text: During the first week, new hires complete security training, receive a laptop, and meet their onboarding buddy.

title: Benefits Overview
text: Halden matches 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of salary for US employees.

title: Safety Procedure: Lockout/Tagout
text: Before servicing any instrument on a live process, apply lockout/tagout and verify zero energy with a second person.

title: Safety Procedure: Protective Equipment
text: Safety glasses and gloves are required in the calibration lab; hearing protection is required near the pump test loop.

title: Facilities: Cafeteria
text: The Redmond campus cafeteria serves lunch from 11:30 to 13:30; Friday features a rotating international menu.

title: Facilities: Parking
text: Visitor parking is in Lot C; employees with EV permits may use chargers for up to four hours.

title: IT Help: VPN
text: If the VPN client shows 'certificate expired', restart the laptop to refresh the device certificate before contacting IT.
